title: What Kinda Music
studio_context: Joint album on Blue Note / Beyond the Groove; reached number 4 in the UK albums chart.

drum_performances.name: Yussef Dayes
drum_performances.why_it_matters: Brought his drumming to a pop audience: slow, linear grooves with kick pairs late in the bar (What Kinda Music), half-time drive (Lift Off), rim-click backbeats (Nightrider).

evidence.note: Rocco Palladino's presence on the album is likely, not checked track by track.
